title: Líder de Loja - Outlet Extrema
description:
Que tal entrar para o nosso #TimedeCampeões ?

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória, é apaixonado por esporte, acredita no trabalho em equipe e está disposto a correr junto com os nossos clientes.


Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória!


Esta convocação é para você, que tem garra e paixão por vencer e quer assumir uma posição estratégica no nosso time. Nossas lideranças de loja garantem a execução dos processos e asseguram os roteiros de atendimento na área de autosserviço e caixa.


Para entrar em campo nesta posição, você precisa:


  • Garantir a execução dos processos operacionais das áreas de vendas da loja, caixa e estoque.
  • Atuar na liderança no caixa da loja.
  • Ser responsável pelas atividades administrativas.
  • Prezar pela excelência no atendimento ao cliente.


Pra jogar bonito, você precisa ter:


  • Ensino Médio completo / desejável Ensino Superior cursando
  • Conhecimento no segmento de varejo
  • Habilidade com o Pacote Office e informática


A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.


Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo!


O clima em loja é de descontração, mas quando chega a hora da partida, cada craque veste a camisa da sua posição e joga junto dos clientes. E se você precisar de ajuda, saiba que nosso time #jogaentrosado , afinal, aqui #miramosotopo.


Muito mais que uma loja, a Centauro é um lugar de histórias escritas por vencedores. Vem fazer seu nome, vem fazer parte do nosso #TimeDeCampeões!

title: Quality and Regulatory Affairs Specialist
description:
About the job

Sol-Millennium is hiring for the position of Quality and Regulatory Affairs Specialist!


Position Summary:

The Quality and Regulatory Affairs (QARA) Specialist will serve as the Responsible Pharmacist. Must be able to provide an active pharmacy license with the Regional Council. The Quality and Regulatory Affairs (QARA) Specialist will serve as the Responsible Pharmacist and play a key role in ensuring the company's compliance with applicable Brazilian regulations and international quality Standards. This position leads complaint handling processes; implements corrective and preventive action plans, ensuring quality throughout the entire product lifecycle; reviews respective documents in the Quality Management System, and attends internal and external audits. This position also supports product launches (ANVISA & INMETRO); provides guidance on regulatory submissions; reviews marketing materials according to the respective regulations; and maintains operational licenses and certifications.


We are looking for a detail-oriented, experienced, and proactive professional with at least 3 years of practical experience and quality responsibilities, supporting compliance initiatives, and supporting regulatory intelligence within the medical device industry. Proven experience in managing cross-functional activities, preparing quality and regulatory files, and supporting product lifecycle from development through post-market activities are essential. Strong communication and collaboration skills, along with a sense of responsibility and commitment within a multidisciplinary team, are highly valued.


Main Activities and Responsibilities:

Act as the company’s Responsible Pharmacist, maintaining an active license with the respective Regional Council, and:

  • Oversee product quality control testing to ensure compliance with specifications and regulatory requirements prior to release.
  • Administer the technical complaints process, including case investigation, documentation, root cause analysis, and development of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  • Actively participate in and support internal and external audits conducted by ANVISA, Inmetro, or notified bodies.
  • Monitor changes in local and international regulations, ensuring timely updates to internal procedures and documentation.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams including R&D, Quality Control, Production, and Marketing to ensure regulatory and quality alignment in all processes.
  • Ensure precise document control and proper retention of technical and regulatory records.
  • Support the launch of new products requiring registration or certification with ANVISA and INMETRO.
  • Prepare, review, and manage regulatory submissions, including product registrations, renewals, changes, and certifications.
  • Maintain Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) certifications, operational licenses, and other mandatory regulatory approvals.
  • Promote and lead a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and compliance within the organization.


Qualifications and Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in pharmacy discipline required.
  • Active license with the respective Brazilian Regional Council (required).
  • Strong knowledge of ANVISA and INMETRO regulatory requirements, including product registration, certification, and licensing processes.
  • Experience managing technical complaints, CAPA systems, and quality/regulatory audits.
  • Familiarity with ISO 13485, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), and Brazilian RDC Standards.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken).

Working Conditions:

  • Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m.
  • Tools provided: Laptop and cell phone.
  • Location: Ribeirão Preto/SP.

Salary and Benefits

  • Salary: Competitive with market rates.
  • Bonus: Eligible for the company’s Bonus Program.
  • Benefits: Health/dental plan (Bradesco TP4), Meal allowance (Ticket Flex), life insurance, and access to Totalpass.


About Sol-Millennium

The Sol-Millennium Group is dedicated to building a healthier and safer tomorrow to help people live in a better world. We offer innovative products through the development and distribution of safe medical devices.


If you’re interested in this position and meet the requirements above, don’t wait — apply now and take part in our selection process!

What We Value

  • Ownership mindset
  • Builders, not just coders

If you are looking for something easy, this is not it.

If you want to be part of a small team doing meaningful work at a high level, we should talk.


Apply here or message me directly.

title: Senior Manager Medical Affairs - LATAM
description:
The Senior Manager, Medical Affairs will be responsible for our Injectables aesthetics business.


Location

Brazil (São Paulo preferred; hybrid/field-based with national travel)



The Senior Manager, Medical Affairs Brazil is responsible for executing the medical strategy for Sinclair's aesthetic injectable portfolio in Brazil & Mexico, leveraging in-market expertise and networks within the aesthetic medicine community. This includes operational medical coverage across the promoted aesthetic portfolio, including compliant HCP engagement, KOL relationship management, and support for protocol implementation and governance for the rollout of new products.. The role ensures scientific excellence, compliant medical engagement, strong KOL partnerships, and effective cross-functional collaboration with Commercial, Regulatory, Quality, and Market Access teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute the LATAM Medical Plan in alignment with Medical Affairs strategy and local business priorities, drawing on deep familiarity with the local aesthetic medicine landscape.
  • Ensure all promotional and educational materials are scientifically sound, evidence-based, and compliant with Brazilian regulations before commercial deployment in collaboration with the regulatory affairs department. Lead the scientific review, adaptation, and in-market rollout of scientific materials, injection protocols including safety communication and HCP training.
  • Identify, map, and cultivate strategic relationships with established aesthetic KOLs and key HCPs across LATAM
  • Lead advisory boards, expert meetings, and scientific exchange activities including the support of local investigator initiated trials (IITs) within the aesthetic community in LATAM
  • Design and deliver high-quality medical education for internal teams and healthcare professionals.
  • Ensure full compliance with local regulations and internal policies, including pharmacovigilance and adverse event reporting.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Regulatory (including ANVISA requirements), Quality, Commercial, and Market Access.
  • Provide timely and scientifically robust responses to medical inquiries.


Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Advanced scientific or clinical degree (MD, PharmD, MSc, or PhD preferred).
  • Minimum 6-8 years’ experience in Medical Affairs, Clinical, or Scientific roles strongly preferred within the field of injectables in the medical aesthetics.
  • Strong experience supporting product launches and lifecycle management.
  • Proven track record of KOL engagement and medical education delivery within aesthetic medicine. Solid understanding of local pharmacovigilance and compliance requirements in LATAM, including ANVISA frameworks. Fluent Portuguese & Spanish and strong English proficiency.


Success Measures (KPIs)

  • Effective delivery of Brazil & Mexico Medical Plan and launch readiness milestones.
  • Successful rollout and adoption of new injectable protocol.
  • Strong KOL engagement and quality scientific exchange.
  • Full compliance with PV and regulatory standards.
  • High-quality cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder satisfaction

title: Coordenador(a) de logística
description:
Sobre Barentz


A Barentz é uma distribuidora líder global de ingredientes de alto desempenho para ciências biológicas. A empresa oferece ingredientes e especialidades dos principais fabricantes em todo o mundo, bem como suporte técnico de valor agregado, incluindo pré-mistura, mistura, formulação de ingredientes e testes de ingredientes em seus centros de formulação e laboratórios de aplicações de última geração na região EMEA, Américas e Ásia-Pacífico.


Fundada em 1953, a Barentz opera em mais de 70 países, com forte presença na Europa e na América do Norte e uma rede em rápido crescimento na América Latina e na Ásia-Pacífico. Com um volume de negócios de 2,5 mil milhões de euros, a empresa emprega mais de 2.500 pessoas em todo o mundo e serve mais de 25.000 clientes. Para mais informações visite nosso site:


Estamos em busca de um(a) Coordenador(a) de Logística para fazer parte do nosso time Operações: Logística.


Missão:

Coordenar as operações logísticas com foco em eficiência, controle e geração de valor, garantindo a integridade dos dados, a confiabilidade dos indicadores e a fluidez dos processos. Atuar de forma estratégica na transformação de dados em insights para tomada de decisão, promovendo melhorias contínuas em custos, nível de serviço e performance operacional, além de desenvolver a equipe e fortalecer a integração entre áreas para assegurar resultados sustentáveis.


Desafios do Cargo:

  • Garantir a qualidade e integridade dos dados logísticos utilizados nas análises e relatórios;
  • Gerar insights relevantes para apoio à tomada de decisão estratégica e tática;
  • Automatizar relatórios e processos analíticos com ferramentas de BI e Excel avançado;

Greenlane is transforming energy production and creating new, sustainable revenue streams for its customers - all while dramatically reducing carbon emissions. Join us, let’s accelerate the energy transition together. Greenlane is a publicly-traded company on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: GRN).


Greenlane is seeking a Procurement Engineer to bridge commercial purchasing with technical evaluation. This role ensures that procured mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation components meet engineering specifications, cost targets, and project requirements. Working closely with Engineering, Operations, Project Management, Supplier Quality, and Finance, this position supports global sourcing, supplier development, and procurement execution for complex engineered materials and equipment.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Identify and qualify suppliers for technical materials, engineered components, and sub-systems.
  • Review engineering drawings, BOMs, schematics, and specifications to ensure correct material and component selection.
  • Evaluate supplier technical capability, manufacturability, quality standards, and compliance.
  • Conduct proposal evaluations using both commercial and technical criteria.
  • Issue RFQs, manage bid analysis, and negotiate pricing, terms, warranties, and delivery.
  • Place purchase orders and manage changes, expediting, documentation, and delivery schedules.
  • Track goods receipts and resolve discrepancies.
  • Monitor supplier performance and drive corrective actions when quality, cost, or schedule issues arise.
  • Support supplier scorecards and performance review cycles.
  • Conduct due diligence and qualification for new suppliers.
  • Work closely with Engineering to clarify specifications and interpret drawings.
  • Interface with Operations, Project Management, and Quality for procurement planning and risk mitigation.
  • Provide procurement inputs for proposals, costing, and project plans.
  • Support cost-reduction, standardization, and value-engineering initiatives.
  • Contribute to internal process improvement projects.


Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt or Lean certification preferred
  • 3–7 years of combined procurement, sourcing, engineering, or supply chain experience in a manufacturing or technical environment.
  • Experience reading engineering drawings and technical specifications is required.
  • Experience working with ERP systems (NetSuite preferred).
  • Experience with mechanical, electrical, or instrumentation components is preferred.
  • Experience with international sourcing and global supplier management is an asset.
  • Effective communicator who can interact with both technical (engineering) and commercial (suppliers, finance) stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of engineering drawings, BOM structures, and technical specifications.
  • Knowledge of supply chain best practices, sourcing strategies, and commercial purchasing processes.
  • Familiarity with quality control standards and regulatory requirements in manufacturing.


How to Apply:

We are an equal opportunity employer and invite applications from all qualified individuals. To be considered for this role, please apply through the Greenlane Renewables page on LinkedIn and attach your resume. While we thank all interested candidates, only those who are short-listed will be contacted.

Se você gosta de construir aplicações robustas, manja de boas práticas, curte trabalhar com arquitetura limpa e quer evoluir em um time que valoriza engenharia, colaboração e aprendizado contínuo, essa oportunidade é pra você!


Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?


Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Habilidades Técnicas:

- .NET Core Apis;

- Micro-serviços;

- SQL Server;

- xUnit (Testes unitários);

- Git;

- RabbitMQ;

- Metodologia ágil (Scrum).


Diferenciais:

- Kafka;

- Docker;

- CI/CD.


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Gympass - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Especialista Manutenção Agrícola
description:
Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Elaborar e desenvolver estratégias proativas de manutenção automotiva, para garantia da confiabilidade de máquinas e processos da área;
  • Estabelecer a harmonização entre os limites operacionais de máquinas, as práticas de execução de manutenção e os custos operacionais, através da engenharia de confiabilidade, PCM e registros de dados de manutenção;
  • Aportar nas unidades práticas de manutenção de classe mundial adaptadas às necessidades de demanda e eficiência das áreas agrícolas;
  • Propor e acompanhar a implementação de novos processos e fluxos de trabalho juntos à gerentes e coordenadores de manutenção dos clusters, para instruir e suportar o sucesso das implementações;
  • Elaborar cronograma de treinamentos obrigatórios e técnicos para a função junto ao RH, a fim de garantir que toda atividade de manutenção esteja sendo executada conforme as normas regulamentadoras (NR’s) previstas em lei, assim como também, garantir a atualização e ampliação dos conhecimentos técnicos da nossa equipe com relação as práticas de manutenção.
  • Elaborar, apoiar na construção e/ou validar, ministrar e/ou garantir o treinamento adequado dos procedimentos de trabalho (POP’s) das atividades que forem pertinentes;
  • Avaliar os processos de manutenção agrícola, observando o cumprimento de normas regulamentadoras, para suporte na conformidade legal e trabalhista;
  • Assegurar a aplicação das práticas de processos seguros nas implementações de métodos que visam aumento de confiabilidade de ativos, tais como MFMEA (Análise de Modos de Falhas de Máquinas e Seus Efeitos), MCC (Manutenção Centrada em Confiabilidade), POP (Procedimento Operacional Padrão), Matriz de Habilidades Técnicas e Designação de Ordens de Serviços;
  • Realizar análise e definição da criticidade dos equipamentos para que sejam adotadas as melhores práticas de manutenção em cada situação;
  • Suportar tecnicamente na elaboração dos MOC's (Projetos de Gestão de Mudanças) buscando e fornecendo informações ligadas aos projetos;
  • Monitorar a aplicação de padrões de trabalho da empresa previamente acordados e estabelecidos com as unidades, propondo e acompanhando ações para correção quando necessário;
  • Suportar o sistema de gestão integrada (SGI) na área de manutenção agrícola.



Requisitos Necessários:

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia Mecânica, Engenharia de Controle e Automação, Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas afins;
  • Sólida experiência em manutenção de equipamentos automotivos;
  • Sólida experiência em indicadores de manutenção, gestão de ativos e de times operacionais e gestão de CAPEX e OPEX;
  • Experiência no setor sucroenergético;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em Orindiúva – SP.

title: Presales Solutions Architect
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Pre Sales Solution Architect who wants to learn and transform his career.


Highly organized and strategic Solution Architect to lead the end-to-end solution design and bid management process for RFP/ proposals in the (IT/Technology/Services) sector. This role is responsible for coordinating multidisciplinary teams to develop compelling, compliant, and competitive proposals in response to RFPs, RFIs, and other customer solicitations, both in public and private sectors.


In this role you will:


  • Identify and qualify new opportunities through working with leads and account leadership and create technical solutions and value propositions by collaborating with expert pool/horizontal solution team.
  • Lead and manage the full bid lifecycle, from opportunity qualification to bid submission and post-submission clarifications.
  • Understand and Document Client Problems and provide IT solutions to address them
  • Drive proactive proposals by working with clients and account teams
  • Drive the contract preparation process from strategy discussions through contract preparation and negotiations.
  • Analyze RFP/RFI/RFQ requirements and define bid strategy in alignment with sales, expert pool/horizontal solution team, and delivery stakeholders.
  • Articulate the differentiators and value of the service line to client stakeholders.
  • Coordinate internal and external contributors (Pre-Sales from other segments, Expert Pool, Legal, Delivery, Finance, Partners, etc.) to ensure timely and high-quality proposal delivery.
  • Develop bid plans, schedules, and compliance matrices to manage tasks, deadlines, and responsibilities.
  • Facilitate value proposition development and ensure the proposal clearly articulates benefits, differentiators, and business impact.
  • Lead internal governance and approvals, including pricing reviews, risk assessments, and executive summaries.
  • Conduct post-bid reviews (win/loss analysis) and capture lessons learned to drive continuous improvement in the bid process.


You must have:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, IT, or related field. Master’s degree is a plus.
  • 5+ years of experience in solution design, bid/proposal management, sales support, or pre-sales roles.
  • Experience in managed services with exposure to emerging tech and AMS (Application Managed Services, CI/CD, SRE)
  • Must have experience in either of these – 1) Cloud ( any of them - Azure, AWS, Google, Oracle) or 2) Data & Analytics (Snowflake, Databricks, PowerBI)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. (Additional languages such as Spanish are a plus.)
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel) and collaboration tools (Teams, SharePoint, etc.).
  • Availability to work from Office/Customer (3x per week - Alphaville)


Good to have:


  • Experience in AI,Gen AI, ML (MS Co-pilot, Google Gemini, Open AI, LLM), legacy modernization, customer experience and digital transformation
  • Strategic thinking and commercial acumen.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and motivate stakeholders.
  • Resilience and adaptability in high-pressure environments.
  • Proactive mindset with continuous improvement focus.


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

title: Bolsista Graduado - DALL PHYTOLAB - Desenvolvimento de métodos analíticos | Talento Inovação -IEL/PR
description:
O Programa Talento Inovação do IEL Paraná tem como foco selecionar, acompanhar e desenvolverbolsistas, além de coordenar ações com organizações parceiras. Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I ) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa. O programa oferece bolsas para graduandos, graduados, mestres e doutores, permitindo atividades de PD&I nas instalações das empresas pelo território nacional, após aprovação da Comissão Interna do IEL Paraná.



Sobre a Oportunidade:


Você tem interesse em desenvolver métodos analíticos inovadores e contribuir diretamente para a evolução da indústria de suplementos alimentares? A Dall PhytoLab S.A., empresa em expansão e referência em análises laboratoriais, está com uma oportunidade única para quem deseja atuar em projetos estratégicos de desenvolvimento e validação de métodos robustos para quantificação de ativos em suplementos.

Estamos em busca de um bolsista para conduzir atividades de pesquisa aplicada com foco em técnicas cromatográficas e espectrofotométricas, atuando no desenvolvimento, otimização e validação de métodos analíticos que possam ser internalizados e replicados pela equipe. O projeto tem como objetivo reduzir a dependência de serviços terceirizados, aumentar a eficiência dos processos internos e ampliar o portfólio de serviços do laboratório, impactando diretamente indicadores como redução de custos, otimização do time-to-market e maior flexibilidade para novas formulações.

Se você busca uma oportunidade de aprendizado prático, quer se desenvolver em um ambiente de excelência técnica e contribuir com soluções de alto impacto para o setor de suplementos, essa oportunidade é para você!



Projeto:

Desenvolvimento e otimização de métodos analíticos para quantificação de ingredientes ativos em suplementos alimentares.



Formação Acadêmica:

Graduado em Química ou Farmácia ou áreas correlatas;


Idioma: Inglês para leitura técnica.


Principais Atividades:


  • Liderar o desenvolvimento e validação dos métodos;
  • Estruturando a documentação técnica;
  • Capacitando a equipe e reduzindo a dependência externa.



Conhecimentos e habilidades necessários:


  • Graduação em Química ou Farmácia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Desenvolvimento e validação de métodos analíticos;
  • Conhecimento em RDCs da ANVISA
  • Técnicas cromatográficas (HPLC, CG) e espectroscópicas.


Ferramentas/metodologias:


  • HPLC, UV/VIS;
  • Validação analítica segundo normas ISO/ANVISA;



Conhecimentos e habilidades desejáveis:


  • Design of Experiments (DoE);
  • Desejável mestrado na área;
  • Operação de GC;




Valor da bolsa (mensal) : Bolsista R$ 4.000,00

Formato de trabalho : Presencial.

Local: Curitiba/PR

title: Analista de Pré-Vendas (BDR Outbound, B2B)

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.


We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.


We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

title: Especialista Segurança do Trabalho (Porto)
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú



O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.



Sobre a Arauco Brasil



No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time?

Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.



Localidade:


Santos/SP



Desafio:


Aplicar as estratégias de Segurança do trabalho e Emergências, trabalhando na prevenção de acidentes e promoção da saúde ocupacional, fazendo cumprir as normas de segurança, monitorando indicadores, se antecipando e evitando situações de Emergências e/ou acidentes, garantindo a consolidação da cultura de segurança, visando um ambiente seguro para todos os colaboradores e minimizando riscos operacionais em sua área de atuação (Fábrica, Logística ou Porto)..


Principais Atividades:


  • Elaborar, implementar, manter e garantir a aprovação de políticas e programas de Segurança do Trabalho, assegurando conformidade com as Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs) e com as necessidades das áreas de atuação (Fábrica, Logística e Porto), promovendo a cultura de segurança.
  • Identificar, avaliar e controlar riscos ocupacionais por meio de APRs, inspeções de segurança e estudos de impacto, elaborando planos de ação para mitigação ou eliminação de riscos como agentes químicos, trabalho em altura, incêndio, movimentação de cargas, operação de empilhadeiras e manobra de vagões.
  • Definir, gerenciar e monitorar o uso adequado de EPIs, garantindo conformidade com a NR‑6, incluindo gestão de contratos, treinamentos, conscientização e fiscalização da utilização correta.
  • Planejar, organizar e ministrar treinamentos obrigatórios e periódicos (NR‑10, NR‑11, NR‑12, NR‑33, NR‑35, entre outros), além de treinamentos de direção defensiva para motoristas e operadores, promovendo campanhas de segurança, emergências e saúde ocupacional.
  • Capacitar equipes de emergência e primeiros socorros para atuação em acidentes e situações críticas.
  • Realizar inspeções periódicas em armazéns, pátios, veículos, equipamentos, máquinas e infraestrutura, garantindo conformidade com as NRs, legislação vigente e padrões de segurança da Arauco.

  • Coordenar a CIPA conforme a NR‑5, garantindo sua eleição, capacitação, funcionamento, reuniões periódicas e execução das ações preventivas.
  • Garantir que os sistemas de prevenção e combate a incêndio estejam instalados, operacionais e em conformidade com a legislação, acompanhando inspeções e manutenções de extintores, hidrantes, sprinklers e alarmes.

  • Desenvolver, acompanhar e utilizar KPIs de Segurança do Trabalho para avaliação da eficácia das ações e suporte à melhoria contínua.
  • Atuar em conjunto com a área de Saúde Ocupacional, apoiando campanhas preventivas, avaliações ergonômicas e ações para redução de LER/DORT e doenças ocupacionais.
  • Manter atualizada a documentação legal e técnica de SST, como laudos, PPRA, PCMSO, LTCAT e relatórios de inspeções e auditorias, além de elaborar relatórios gerenciais periódicos.
  • Garantir a conformidade contínua com a legislação de Segurança do Trabalho, acompanhando alterações normativas e ajustando políticas e procedimentos internos.
  • Apoiar projetos de melhoria, inovação, modernização e automação de processos relacionados à Segurança do Trabalho e Emergências, visando eficiência operacional e otimização de custos;
  • Propagar, cumprir e fazer cumprir a política de Meio Ambiente, qualidade, Segurança e Saúde Ocupacional, bem como, a política de ética e Compliance, por todos os colaboradores próprios e terceiros, assegurando o cumprimento da legislação e outros compromissos previstos, em todas as atividades produtos e serviços, incluindo os princípios e critérios das normas e ISOs;

title: Salesforce Consultant
description:
Job Title: Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst


Introduction: We are seeking a highly skilled Salesforce CRM Systems Analyst with 7 to 10 years of experience to join our dynamic team. This role is pivotal in optimizing and managing our Salesforce ecosystem, driving business growth through effective CRM solutions. The ideal candidate will leverage their expertise in Sales Cloud , application administration , integration , and AI-led automation to enhance user experience, streamline processes, and deliver actionable insights. This position plays a critical role in aligning Salesforce capabilities with organizational goals, ensuring seamless collaboration across departments and maximizing CRM value.


Roles and Responsibilities:


  • Lead the administration and configuration of the Salesforce Sales Cloud platform to support business processes and user requirements.
  • Design, develop, and implement integrations between Salesforce and third-party systems to ensure data consistency and process automation.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Manage and optimize Salesforce application administration tasks including user management, security roles, profiles, workflows, and validation rules.
  • Drive AI-led automation initiatives within Salesforce to enhance sales productivity and decision-making using tools such as Einstein Analytics and AI-driven workflows .
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement enhancements to maintain optimal CRM functionality.
  • Develop training materials and conduct user training sessions to promote adoption and effective use of Salesforce features.
  • Stay current with Salesforce releases, features, and best practices to continuously improve system capabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with IT, sales, marketing, and customer service teams to ensure Salesforce supports cross-functional business needs.

Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 7 to 10 years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Systems Analyst or Administrator with a focus on Sales Cloud .
  • Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Certified Administrator , Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant , or equivalent are highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience in application administration, configuration, and customization of Salesforce environments.
  • Proven expertise in integrating Salesforce with external applications using APIs, middleware, or integration platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of AI-led automation tools within Salesforce, including Einstein Analytics and process automation capabilities.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively across teams.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and project management is a plus.

Tools and Technologies:


  • Salesforce Sales Cloud
  • Salesforce Application Administration (User Management, Security, Workflows, Validation Rules)
  • Salesforce Integration Tools (APIs, REST/SOAP, Middleware like MuleSoft, Dell Boomi)
  • AI-led Automation Tools (Salesforce Einstein, Einstein Analytics, AI-driven Process Automation)
  • Data Management and Reporting tools within Salesforce
  • Familiarity with Agile project management software (e.g., Jira, Confluence)

title: Growth & Strategy Manager
description:
ABOUT COTY

Coty is one of the world’s largest beauty companies, with an iconic portfolio of fragrance, color cosmetics, skincare, and body care brands. At Coty, we celebrate and nurture a culture of kindness. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We believe that beauty lies in diversity and are committed to continuing to build an environment where all talents can thrive. We deeply value the unique contributions each individual brings to our team. As part of our commitment to inclusion, all profiles are welcome.


MISSION


Lead the Growth & Strategy agenda by defining medium and long-term strategic priorities and ensuring that resources: capital, people, and focus are allocated to initiatives with the highest economic and strategic return. Act as a vital bridge between strategy, growth, and execution, with a strong focus on Brand Finance for Innovation, ensuring that launches and growth initiatives have a solid financial foundation and contribute to sustainable value creation.


RESPONSIBILITIES


Corporate Strategy & Portfolio

  • Define and update the medium and long-term growth strategy.
  • Conduct structural analyses of categories, channels, consumers, and profit pools.
  • Support leadership in defining \"where to play and how to win\" (strategic priorities).
  • Translate strategy into clear and executable roadmaps.


Growth & Innovation Frontiers

  • Identify and unlock new growth horizons, including white spaces, new categories, and digital-first business models.
  • Drive the innovation engine by scouting for adjacencies to the core business and assessing their scalability.
  • Lead analyses of organic and inorganic opportunities to accelerate market entry and new business possibilities.
  • Build and manage a structured pipeline of growth initiatives, ensuring they align with the company's long-term transformation.
  • Lead cross-functional strategic projects, such as category re-design and digital acceleration.


Innovation Finance (Brand Finance)

  • Act as a Brand Finance Partner with a focus on innovation, leading financial analyses for launches and strategic projects (business cases, payback, margin impact).
  • Evaluate and propose trade-offs between growth, investment, and profitability.
  • Monitor post-launch performance against the business case to continuously improve the quality of future projections.
  • Support Innovation, Marketing, and Trade teams in project prioritization, investment sizing, and “go/no-go” decisions.


Governance & Interfaces

  • Structure and lead decision-making forums for growth and innovation.
  • Define clear prioritization criteria based on strategic impact, risk, and ROI.
  • Work integrated with Revenue Management (coherence between strategy, mix, and monetization), Marketing (brand strategy), Finance (P&L and capital allocation), and Sales (alignment between long-term strategy and short-term commercial decisions).


REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, or related fields.
  • Advanced or Fluent English — essential for interaction with global teams and strategic reporting.
  • Solid background in Strategic Planning, Business Development, or Finance, specifically within Business Partnering or Brand Finance roles.
  • Proven track record in developing complex financial models, robust business cases, and in-depth market analysis.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to navigate and influence within complex, matrixed organizational environments.

title: Engenheiro de processos sênior
description:
A Borborema Recursos Estratégicos é uma empresa brasileira que nasceu para transformar possibilidades em realidade. Desde 2021, atuamos na Bahia com foco em pesquisa mineral de terras raras, minerais essenciais para tecnologias modernas e para a transição energética.

Nosso objetivo é unir inovação, responsabilidade e eficiência para construir um futuro sustentável. Somos subsidiárias da Brazilian Rare Earths e trabalhamos para posicionar o Brasil como protagonista no setor.


MISSÃO DO CARGO:

Desenvolver estudos e análises complexas, relacionados às atividades no campo da engenharia de processos, respondendo por identificar e quantificar recursos minerais, desenvolvendo projetos de beneficiamento de minérios e metalurgia de terras raras e elementos estratégicos, por meio da realização de estudos técnicos e análises críticas de processos, para viabilizar a produção sustentável de minérios e compostos metálicos com abrangência em toda a operação da empresa, e garantir implementação de melhorias em processos e novas tecnologias.


RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO

Suportar as atividades de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de rotas de processo de beneficiamento mineral e metalurgia aplicáveis ao processo de produção de elementos de terras raras e minerais estratégicos em escala de bancada, piloto e industrial, visando otimização e inovação.


Acompanhar a realização de testes metalúrgicos de beneficiamento mineral ou metalurgia em laboratórios internos, externos e Centros de Pesquisa, garantindo a qualidade dos processos e atendendo às demandas de P&D da empresa.


Revisar documentação de projetos de beneficiamento mineral e metalurgia nas diversas fases (Scoping Study até Feasibility Study), apoiando na elaboração e revisão de fluxogramas de processo e engenharia, com o objetivo de assegurar a precisão técnica dos estudos.


Atuar de forma consultiva juntamente ao corpo técnico, direcionando na elaboração e execução de programas de testes metalúrgicos e na avaliação e consolidação de informações de processos, contribuindo para a eficiência operacional.


Elaborar e revisar relatórios e apresentações para suportar as decisões da Gerência de Processos e P&D, comunicando os resultados de forma clara e objetiva para a tomada de decisões estratégicas.


Apoiar a equipe de Engenharia, Engenharia de Minas e PMO nos estudos da disciplina de Processos para planta de beneficiamento mineral e hidrometalurgia, fornecendo suporte técnico e contribuindo para a resolução de problemas.


Cumprir e fazer cumprir as normas e metas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente, promovendo uma cultura organizacional de responsabilidade e prevenção.


Participar ativamente na formação e desenvolvimento da equipe técnica, disseminando conhecimentos e melhorando as competências do time em processos de beneficiamento mineral.


REQUISITOS DO CARGO

Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Engenharia de Minas, Engenharia Química, Engenharia Metalúrgica e outras afins.


Idioma: Inglês Intermediário/Avançado


Disponibilidade para residir em Salvador/BA ou Lauro de Freitas/BA.

Disponibilidade para atuar eventualmente em regime de turno.


Competências Técnicas: Sólidos conhecimentos em processos metalúrgicos, beneficiamento mineral, elaboração de estudos de viabilidade, gerenciamento de projetos e domínio de softwares de modelagem de processos.


COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS

Proatividade, orientação para resultados, habilidades de comunicação, trabalho em equipe, capacidade de análise crítica, resolução de problemas complexos, flexibilidade e espírito inovador.

title: Senior .Net Developer
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Contractor)

Job Type: Full-time (Remote)

Pay: R$20,000.00 – R$22,000.00 per month


Resume:

English version only.

Highlight SAAS projects, healthcare related projects, and HIPAA experience.

Highlight experiences in .NET MVC and .NET Maui


Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer contractor to join our U.S.-based team remotely. You will leverage your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects.

In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to our Agile workflow via Azure DevOps . You will begin with automated testing and peer reviews , expanding into broader development tasks by months 2–3. Your role will evolve based on your strengths and our needs — all while adhering to rigorous coding and security standards .


Key Responsibilities

1. Product Design & Development

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to design software solutions aligned with technical and business objectives.
  • Write, optimize, and maintain efficient code, including enhancing existing codebases (opportunities starting around months 3–4).

2. Testing & Quality

  • Design and implement automated End-to-End (E2E) tests (e.g., using Microsoft Playwright) to ensure feature stability — with a strong focus during your first 6–9 months.

3. Peer Reviews & Post-Release Support

  • Participate in pre-release feature reviews (ongoing).
  • Conduct initial post-release bug ticket analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.

4. Agile Collaboration

  • Actively contribute to 2-week sprints and 6-week release cycles (3 sprints per release).
  • Participate in sprint planning, pull requests, releases, and daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT).

5. Communication & Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members across time zones.


Qualifications

Experience

  • 8 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record on complex projects.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Application (.NET 8) for mobile and web development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
  • Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with healthcare software or Protected Health Information standards (e.g., HIPAA).
  • Experience with pull request reviews and sprint participation.


How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: 2-week sprints, 6-week release cycles, daily stand-ups at 3:00 PM CT.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.g., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tools: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and more.
  • Team Culture: Accountability, quality, and excellence in delivery.

Com o apoio dos nossos acionistas — Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau e Tigre —, movimentamos mais de R$10 bilhões em nossa Loja Virtual em 2024, impactando mais de 100 mil lojas e 1,2 milhão de membros entre lojistas, vendedores e profissionais de obra.

Aqui, valorizamos quem se dedica a entender as dores reais do varejo e busca, com consistência, soluções que gerem valor e resultados para os nossos usuários.

O futuro do varejo da construção civil tá sendo construído agora — e pode ser com você.

Na BRK, respeito, diversidade e inclusão são valores inegociáveis! Atuamos para promover um ambiente positivo, inovador, ético, inclusivo, seguro e de respeito às pessoas.

title: Especialista Técnico SAP I
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Arquitetura e Governança de Soluções (Keep the Core Clean): Atuar como autoridade técnica e ponto focal para decisões de design em ambientes ABAP e SAP BTP. Garantir a integridade do sistema através da estratégia Keep the Core Clean, definindo padrões de arquitetura (In-app e Side-by-side) que assegurem a escalabilidade e a facilidade de futuras atualizações do ERP.
  • Liderança Técnica e Excelência em Engenharia : Liderar a squad técnica estabelecendo e zelando por padrões de alta performance, segurança e qualidade de código (Clean ABAP). Realizar Code Reviews críticos e auditorias técnicas para garantir que as entregas do time (interno ou terceirizado) estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Inovação e Modernização do Ecossistema : Direcionar a adoção de tecnologias de ponta e novos modelos de programação, como SAP Fiori, RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) e CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes.
  • Interface Estratégica e Tradução de Negócio : Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas funcionais, Gerentes de Projetos e o time técnico. Traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em especificações técnicas viáveis, garantindo que as expectativas dos stakeholders sejam atendidas com soluções tecnicamente sustentáveis.
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida e Mentoria : Supervisionar o ciclo de vida completo das soluções (do desenho técnico ao deploy e sustentação). Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time.
  • Ambiente Tecnológico e Desafio: Atuar em um ecossistema (Híbrido / Cloud) de alta criticidade, sendo o guardião da transição tecnológica de legados ABAP para modelos modernos no SAP S/4HANA. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP.
  • Funcionais e Negócio : Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas.
  • Desenvolvimentos e Projetos: Interface com Gerentes de Projeto e Funcionais para definição de cronogramas técnicos, estimativas de esforço e priorização de backlogs baseada em viabilidade e impacto.
  • Metas Estratégicas do Cargo : Modernização do Core: Atingir KPIs de redução de customizações \"Z\" tradicionais em favor de extensões Side-by-Side e otimização do consumo de serviços no SAP BTP para evitar custos excedentes.
  • Qualidade e Estabilidade : Redução do Lead Time de desenvolvimento e diminuição de incidentes em PRD causados por falhas de transporte ou performance.
  • Nível de Maturidade Técnica : Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Ecossistema SAP: Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade, com protagonismo técnico. Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem.
  • Domínio de Desenvolvimento Moderno: Vivência profunda em programação ABAP (Standard e OO) em versões 7.5+; Utilização do Eclipse (ADT) e CDS Views.
  • Experiência com Extensibilidade e Cloud: Experiência prática na construção de extensões e integrações utilizando SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform).
  • Histórico de Liderança Técnica: Experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica (Tech Lead), sendo responsável por arquitetura de software, revisão de código (Code Review) e mentoria de desenvolvedores menos experientes.
  • Vivência em Metodologias Ágeis: Experiência de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos utilizando Scrum ou Kanban.

description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role

JoVE is seeking a Sales Enablement Specialist - Digital Course Materials & Access Programs to support the operational delivery and adoption of JoVE’s digital science video platform across higher education institutions.

This role sits within the Sales Enablement team and focuses on managing course material adoptions, supporting bookstore affordability programs such as Inclusive Access and Equitable Access, and ensuring the reliable delivery of JoVE content through Learning Management Systems (LMS).

While JoVE’s Customer Success team works directly with faculty on course-level implementation, this role focuses on operational workflows, adoption tracking, data analysis, and identifying trends or systemic issues affecting digital course material delivery.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational and analytical skills with meaningful experience working with LMS platforms and LTI-based integrations used in higher education courseware delivery.


Responsibilities:

  • Manage course material adoptions and digital product fulfillment across higher education accounts.
  • Support the implementation and administration of Inclusive Access and Equitable Access programs with university bookstores.
  • Coordinate course setup and delivery of digital materials through bookstore distribution systems.
  • Analyze sales, adoption, and fulfillment data to create reports and dashboards that support forecasting, planning, and decision-making.
  • Provide insights to Sales leadership on adoption performance and program growth.
  • Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities in bookstore and digital distribution workflows.
  • Monitor workflows that support JoVE content delivery through Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, D2L, etc.). Recommend process improvements and system enhancements to support scalable program delivery.
  • Apply working knowledge of LTI integrations and LMS courseware delivery models to diagnose access or authentication issues.


Requirements

  • A Bachelor’s degree
  • 3+ years experience in EdTech, digital publishing, sales operations, or academic technology environments
  • Strong familiarity with Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, Brightspace, etc.)
  • Demonstrated experience working with LTI integrations or LMS-based courseware delivery
  • Strong experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms
  • Results-driven, strong organization and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently in a fast paced environment


Why JoVE?

  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview


Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company’s foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.


Key Responsibilities


Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.


Required Qualifications & Skills


Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.


Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.


Benefits & Compensation

Gestão de Pessoal e Workforce Planning

  • Conhecimento de folha de pagamento e suas provisões contábeis.

You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.


The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

strategy.


Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN , pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter


Required Qualifications

  • Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.
  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)


Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Demand Planner
description:
DEMAND PLANNER


DyStar is seeking to fulfill a key role to support the Supply Chain Manager for Brazil. The successful candidate will have 2 years international planning and replenishment experience. This is an on-site role in Sao Paulo (not open to remote or hybrid work).


Must be able to communicate in English with the Americas Regional Headquarters in the United States and with the Global Headquarters in Singapore- must have good skills in writing and speaking.


Job Summary:

  • Perform Demand Planning and Replenishment activities of Finished Goods based on Actual Sales, Forecast, Inventory on hand, material in transit, open Purchase Orders and Production Lead Time in order to determine the optimum size of inventory in accordance with Global and Regional parameters.
  • Place Purchase Orders in accordance to Demand Planning needs, and guarantee correct follow up of each one of them, as to accomplish timely delivery of the material to the required plants.
  • Control and manage all aspects of planning activities, maintain correct inventory levels to support company goals and customer service needs, as well as avoid/minimize over stock, unhealthy inventory and short supply
  • Assist with maintenance of data bases in MRP and guarantee Open POs are maintained at minimum levels. Attend priority and planning meetings, outage coordination meetings and scheduled review meetings and be prepared to actively participate as required.


Supervisory Responsibilities: None


Job Responsibilities:

  • Prepare correct information for the monthly planning meeting to support the monthly planning activities, ensuring the participation and communication with Sales, Marketing, BM and related areas together with the SCM team with the objective to propose replenishment at adequate quantities and guarantee delivery of products in timely manner in accordance to Global and Regional requirements.
  • Elaborate and update the planning report to be presented in S&OP meetings, which contains: products, sales, forecast, inventory in all plants related to the planning scope, production schedule per product, material in transit, open purchase orders, new orders to be placed, overstock and stock transfers (between plants)
  • Elaborate and update the purchase orders report as to follow each line item in the purchase order with pre allocation or allocation date, or production schedule, shipping details, documents corresponding to each shipment (invoice, packing list, B/L, COA, etc.)
  • Follow DOA (Delegation of Authority) process when entering Purchasing Requisition or Purchase Orders.
  • In case of airfreight orders needed, request corresponding authorization as per DOA, before placement
  • Ensures critical analysis of inventory levels to support Company goals and manages the development of creative solutions to anticipate inventory short supply issues
  • Prepares Unhealthy Inventory Reports monthly to be presented to Business Managers and Sales Teams so Unhealthy Inventory can be properly managed, and necessary actions are timely addressed
  • Creates, monitors, and maintains S&OP metrics and key performance indicators, identifying resulting risks and opportunities
  • Helps to develop advanced analytical tools and reporting figures to support the entire planning and purchasing process
  • Facilitate cross-functional communication among the Business Units, Supply Chain and Local teams in support of major Planning & Purchasing initiatives, factory productivity, inventory levels, distribution, transportation, etc.
  • Reviews short/mid/long term demand plans, follows up on their execution with Sales team and Business Managers to align forecast outlook.
  • Analyzes internal demand stream information and categorizes according to demand patterns.
  • Gets consensus forecast among Sales/Marketing/Business Managers and Supply Chain.
  • Aligns Production Schedule of Suppliers and Production Facilities with Purchasing Plan in order to take the best benefit of freight charges and shipping opportunities.
  • Manages and coordinates Process Improvements initiatives based on Lean Manufacturing concepts
  • Coordinates development and homologation processes of new Service Providers


Experience and Education Requirements:

• A degree in International Trade, International Business, International Relations or related degree and

• 2 years of experience in International Planning and Replenishment or equivalent experience.


Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

• Excellent analytical skills

• Excellent computer skills, with advanced skill in MS Excel

title: Purchasing Manager
description:
SWM International is a multinational company specialized in producing paper for the tobacco industry and solutions in specialty papers. We are expert manufacturers of a variety of advanced materials that are part of people’s everyday lives. We contribute to our customers’ success by delivering high-quality products and collaborating to provide innovative and customized solutions that enhance the value of their offerings.


Now, we invite you to be part of our daily journey, where each employee is essential to the success of our company.


Bring your talent to SWM!

We are currently looking for a Purchasing Manager to join our team in a permanent position at our unit in Piraí, Rio de Janeiro.


Position Objective

Lead regional operational buying teams in executing global procurement strategies while managing supplier relationships locally and interfacing with key stakeholders like plant operational and maintenance teams. This role ensures compliance, operational excellence, cost optimization, and supply continuity by bridging the gap between corporate global strategy and regional business needs.


Your challenges will include:

1. Operational Leadership & Strategy Execution

  • Manage Regional Buying Teams: Lead and develop the operational procurement team to ensure high performance, process compliance, and professional growth.
  • Implement global framework agreement: work closely with category leaders to roll out global contracts regionally, ensuring local requirements are met without compromising global leverage.
  • Drive orocess excellence: Apply Lean/Six Sigma principles to streamline the \"procure-to-pay\" cycle and improve regional buying efficiency.

2. Market Intelligence & Analysis

  • Monitor market trends: Analyze regional indices, competitor behavior, and technical developments to forecast price fluctuations and supply risks.
  • Benchmarking: Regularly compare regional pricing and commercial terms against competitors to maintain a competitive edge while ensuring full legal and anti-trust compliance.
  • Data-driven reporting: Consolidate market research and internal KPIs into actionable monthly reports to guide executive decision-making.

3. Supplier & Stakeholder Management

  • Local face to suppliers: Act as the primary regional point of contact for key suppliers to resolve escalations, conduct performance reviews, and ensure service level agreements (SLAs) are met.
  • Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify supply chain bottlenecks and develop alternative sourcing formulations or backup plans.
  • Sourcing: Lead team to run competitive tenders for categories under direct responsibility

4. Continuous Improvement & Compliance

  • Knowledge Leadership: Stay current on industry innovations and digital procurement tools to suggest improvements in commercial positioning.
  • EHS & Quality Standards: Ensure all regional purchasing activities strictly adhere to Health, Safety, Environment, and corporate governance guidelines.
  • Compliance: Establish and enforce local procedures, ensuring transparency in the purchasing activities



What we’re looking for:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Administration, Engineering, or related fields
  • Experience: Solid knowledge of purchasing processes, negotiation, and import/export regulations;

title: EHS Supervisor
description:
About Envision

Envision is a global green technology group committed to accelerating the energy transition through integrated renewable, storage, digital and hydrogen solutions.

Envision provides renewable energy system solutions to corporations, governments, and institutions worldwide, reducing the cost of renewable energy production, storage, and integration through continuous technological innovation. The company’s business spans smart wind turbines, energy storage, and green hydrogen solutions.

Today, Envision operates as an integrated net-zero technology ecosystem, combining hardware, software, and system integration capabilities across the full energy value chain.

The Group maintains a strong international presence with:

20+ R&D and operations centers

50+ manufacturing bases

80+ GW of installed wind capacity globally

10+ GWh of delivered storage capacity

Expanding green hydrogen industrial platforms

Over 50% of the international workforce


Key Platforms

Smart Wind Turbines

Envision’s smart wind platform integrates advanced sensing, digital models and digital twin technologies via the Galileo SuperSense System. With 80+ GW installed globally, Envision ranks first globally in orders and second in new installations since 2022, maintaining a leading international market position.

Energy Storage

The energy storage platform provides full-stack capabilities across battery cells, BMS, PCS, EMS and SCADA, delivering integrated end-to-end solutions. The business ranks third in China and fourth globally, with 200+ projects and 15+ GWh in orders. The ecosystem includes Envision AESC (global battery leader) and Univers (AIoT-enabled digital energy management platform).

Green Hydrogen

Envision is developing large-scale integrated green hydrogen and ammonia industrial parks, including one of the world’s largest net-zero hydrogen projects in Chifeng, Inner Mongolia (1.5 million tons planned annual capacity).

  • Promote safety awareness through toolbox talks and on-site training
  • Ensure compliance with local regulations and company EHS policies
  • Support emergency preparedness, including drills and response coordination

  • Bachelor’s degree or technical qualification in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, or related fields
  • Experience in EHS within wind farm, construction, or energy projects is preferred
  • Strong knowledge of high-risk activities (lifting, working at heights, electrical safety)
  • Familiarity with local EHS regulations and standards
  • Experience supervising contractors on-site
  • Advanced English (to be tested)
  • Availability to work on-site and travel as required

title: Engenheiro de processos sênior
description:
A Borborema Recursos Estratégicos é uma empresa brasileira que nasceu para transformar possibilidades em realidade. Desde 2021, atuamos na Bahia com foco em pesquisa mineral de terras raras, minerais essenciais para tecnologias modernas e para a transição energética.

Nosso objetivo é unir inovação, responsabilidade e eficiência para construir um futuro sustentável. Somos subsidiárias da Brazilian Rare Earths e trabalhamos para posicionar o Brasil como protagonista no setor.


MISSÃO DO CARGO:

Desenvolver estudos e análises complexas, relacionados às atividades no campo da engenharia de processos, respondendo por identificar e quantificar recursos minerais, desenvolvendo projetos de beneficiamento de minérios e metalurgia de terras raras e elementos estratégicos, por meio da realização de estudos técnicos e análises críticas de processos, para viabilizar a produção sustentável de minérios e compostos metálicos com abrangência em toda a operação da empresa, e garantir implementação de melhorias em processos e novas tecnologias.


RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO

Suportar as atividades de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de rotas de processo de beneficiamento mineral e metalurgia aplicáveis ao processo de produção de elementos de terras raras e minerais estratégicos em escala de bancada, piloto e industrial, visando otimização e inovação.


Acompanhar a realização de testes metalúrgicos de beneficiamento mineral ou metalurgia em laboratórios internos, externos e Centros de Pesquisa, garantindo a qualidade dos processos e atendendo às demandas de P&D da empresa.


Revisar documentação de projetos de beneficiamento mineral e metalurgia nas diversas fases (Scoping Study até Feasibility Study), apoiando na elaboração e revisão de fluxogramas de processo e engenharia, com o objetivo de assegurar a precisão técnica dos estudos.


Atuar de forma consultiva juntamente ao corpo técnico, direcionando na elaboração e execução de programas de testes metalúrgicos e na avaliação e consolidação de informações de processos, contribuindo para a eficiência operacional.


Elaborar e revisar relatórios e apresentações para suportar as decisões da Gerência de Processos e P&D, comunicando os resultados de forma clara e objetiva para a tomada de decisões estratégicas.


Apoiar a equipe de Engenharia, Engenharia de Minas e PMO nos estudos da disciplina de Processos para planta de beneficiamento mineral e hidrometalurgia, fornecendo suporte técnico e contribuindo para a resolução de problemas.


Cumprir e fazer cumprir as normas e metas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente, promovendo uma cultura organizacional de responsabilidade e prevenção.


Participar ativamente na formação e desenvolvimento da equipe técnica, disseminando conhecimentos e melhorando as competências do time em processos de beneficiamento mineral.


REQUISITOS DO CARGO

Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Engenharia de Minas, Engenharia Química, Engenharia Metalúrgica e outras afins.


Idioma: Inglês Intermediário/Avançado


Disponibilidade para residir em Salvador/BA ou Lauro de Freitas/BA.

Disponibilidade para atuar eventualmente em regime de turno.


Competências Técnicas: Sólidos conhecimentos em processos metalúrgicos, beneficiamento mineral, elaboração de estudos de viabilidade, gerenciamento de projetos e domínio de softwares de modelagem de processos.


COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS

Proatividade, orientação para resultados, habilidades de comunicação, trabalho em equipe, capacidade de análise crítica, resolução de problemas complexos, flexibilidade e espírito inovador.
